description: External control of the quality of construction, listed by ZAG under its external control work for DARS (1998 to 2014). The list covers thirteen motorway tunnels and the repair works in the Karavanke motorway and railway tunnels. ZAG does not give dates for each tunnel. ZAG also lists this tunnel under geological-geotechnical investigations for the design of motorway tunnels, DARS 1990 to 2013.

source_differences: Name: the 1999 location plan calls it Tabor I/II (km 7.420-7.940 / 7.414-7.947, 520/533 m), the as-built tunnel at km 7.360-7.975 is named Podnanos (URSZR, OSM, Structurae). 'Tabor' as-built is the adjacent viaduct. Lotsberg lists 'Podnanos (Tabor)'.
Do not confuse with the A3 Tabor tunnel near Sežana (289/282 m, 1997, Lotsberg).
Lengths: design 520/533 m (1999 plan) vs as-built 612/590 m (Structurae, Lotsberg) or 614/589 m (URSZR).
Identity: the ZAG list names only "Tabor". Lotsberg lists two tunnels, Podnanos (Tabor) on the H4 and Tabor on the A3 near Sežana, so the choice of the H4 tunnel is an inference.
